messages:
emily-partnerships: FYI NebulaCloud just sent manifest update 1: 40 racks NVX-80x split into two shipments. Need allocation decision before our co-announcement tomorrow.

anna-logistics: Details: 30 racks ETA 2026-03-30 (us-west port), 10 racks ETA 2026-04-12 (eu-central). Split caused by a customs quota at the EU port.

raj-sales: Can we go with a NA-first launch messaging? Partner wants a clear plan - they'll consider paying to expedite if necessary.

lucas-ops: Ops impact: we currently have 24 NVX-80x reserved for Dedicated; we can spare 6 for marketplace in us-west without SLO risk. If EU racks are delayed, marketplace capacity drops ~25%.

sam-engineering: Engineering mitigation: we can toggle a cloud fallback for EU traffic for ~2 weeks. Small routing change + feature flag. Work: PR for `canary-config.yaml` and `route-policy` update.

anna-logistics: Expedited airlift option: ~USD45k + brokerage, ETA ~2026-04-03 if approved today. Risk: customs still possible hold.

kathy-legal: Current joint announcement copy says "Available in NA & EU". Recommend changing to "NA available at launch; EU availability expected in April, subject to shipping and customs."

emily-partnerships: Decision proposal: NA-first public messaging, enable cloud fallback for EU as contingency, ask partner if they want to fund airlift as a backup. Raj, can you ask NebulaCloud on the 09:00 PT sync?

raj-sales: Yes. I'll present both options (airlift vs cloud fallback cost) and ask them to commit.

lucas-ops: I'll reserve 6 NVX-80x in us-west and add autoscaler limits so reserved customers aren't impacted. Canary ramp plan: 10% -> 30% over 3 hours.

sam-engineering: I'll prepare the feature-flag PR and a short rollback playbook. Deploy bot notes: will wait for capacity confirmation before canary.

emily-partnerships: Thanks all. I'll update the co-announcement draft, tag @kathy for redlines, and mark EU availability as conditional until we have final delivery confirmation.
